

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let owner = String::from("borrowed");



let inspect = |extra: usize| {
  
    

return owner.len() + extra;



  
}
;


let length = inspect(2)
;



assert_eq!(length, 10); assert_eq!(owner, "borrowed");




let assigned;



assigned = |value: i32| -> (i32) {
  
    

return value * 2;



  
}
;


let doubled = assigned(9)
;



assert_eq!(doubled, 18); assert_eq!(owner.len(), 8);



    
}
